about.title: Hi, I'm Armen — local, hands-on, and easy to reach.
about.p1: I run EginyanConstruction myself. From the first visit to the final walkthrough, you deal with me directly — no salespeople, no hand-offs, no guessing who's showing up at your home.
about.p2: I take on a limited number of projects at a time so each one gets my full attention. I show up when I say I will, keep the work area clean, and don't call a job finished until the details are right.
